title: 2027 Honda Civic Hatchback Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Honda Civic Hatchback introduces a Sport-L trim for gas models and new Honda S+ Shift technology for hybrid versions.
body_markdown:
The Honda Civic Hatchback is a stalwart compact car offered with gas and hybrid powertrains and front-wheel drive. Rivals include the Toyota Corolla, the Hyundai Elantra, the Kia K4, and the Mazda3.

## What’s New for the 2027 Honda Civic Hatchback


The 2027 version of the Honda Civic Hatchback gets a notable feature update, as well as a new trim level. The new trim, available only with gas models, is called Sport-L and adds several luxury features that were reserved for the top-end Sport Hybrid Touring. The hybrid powertrain gains new Honda S+ Shift technology, a feature introduced for the Honda Prelude coupe. The S+ Shift function simulates gear shifts in the continuously variable automatic transmission (CVT), including virtual rev-matched downshifts, gear holding, and enhanced engine sounds under hard acceleration.


## Design


The Civic Hatchback has a sleek, sporty look. It takes on a fastback form rather than the two-box look of other hatchbacks. The profile has a rising character line between the wheels and the window line rises at the rear. Up front, the grille and wide rectangular LED headlights stretch across the face like a thin smile, and the headlights sport checkmark-shaped LED daytime running lights. A large air intake sits down low, with thin intakes at either side. The rear features a small lip spoiler and LED taillights joined by a full-width light bar. Honda sets it on 18-inch alloy wheels.


## Powertrain


Gas-powered Honda Civic Hatchbacks use a 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine mated to a CVT. The engine makes 150 horsepower and 133 pound-feet of torque in the base Sport model. The two hybrids add an electric motor to increase output to 200 hp and 232 lb-ft of torque. All models are front-wheel drive. The gas-only Civic Hatchback is EPA-rated at 30 mpg city, 38 mpg highway, and 34 mpg combined, while hybrid versions boost fuel efficiency to 50 mpg/44 mpg/47 mpg.


## Interior


The Civic Hatchback seats up to five passengers. The front seats come standard with cloth upholstery and manual seat adjustment. Sport pedals with metal covers, automatic climate control, and red ambient lighting are also standard. The Sport-L and Sport Hybrid add heated front seats and dual-zone automatic climate control, and the Sport Hybrid gets a sunroof. The Sport-L and Sport Touring Hybrid also add an eight-way power-adjustable driver’s seat, a four-way power-adjustable front passenger seat, and leather upholstery. The rear seat folds flat in a 60/40 split to increase cargo space from the standard 24.5 cubic feet behind it.


## Technology


The Civic Hatchback gets a standard 7-inch digital instrument cluster, a 9-inch infotainment touchscreen, wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, and an eight-speaker, 180-watt audio system. The top Sport Touring Hybrid upgrades to a 10.2-inch digital instrument cluster, Alexa built-in, Google built-in with a three-month data plan for in-vehicle apps, and a Google Gemini assistant. The Sport Touring Hybrid also has wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, wireless smartphone charging, a Wi-Fi hotspot, and a 12-speaker Bose audio system.

## Safety


The Civic Hatchback has a good set of safety features as standard and offers a couple more. The standard set includes forward-collision warning, automatic emergency braking, lane-departure warning, lane-keep assist, adaptive cruise control, traffic-sign recognition, blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert, traffic-jam assist, road-departure mitigation, and high-beam assist. Top-spec models also have front and rear parking sensors and low-speed automatic braking. The Civic Hatchback did well in crash tests, earning a Top Safety Pick from the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety and five out of five stars in National Highway Traffic Safety Administration testing.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Honda Civic Hatchback is on sale now in Sport, Sport-L, Sport Hybrid, and Sport Touring Hybrid trim levels. At the time of writing, the Sport cost $29,490, including a $1,245 destination fee. The Sport-L, which is due by the end of 2026, starts at $30,990. The Sport Hybrid runs $32,190, and the top-end Sport Touring Hybrid costs $35,190.
